title: Self-Dual Envelope of a Module Function
body_html:
Self-Dual Envelope of a Module Function

Let \(N\) be an \(o_D\)-module function with jumps in \((1/(2m))\mathbb Z\) and satisfying the required almost-self-dual pairing estimate. Then there exists a self-dual lattice function \(L\) with jumps in \((1/(2m))\mathbb Z\) such that \[ N_t\subseteq L_{t+1/(2m)}. \]
proof_html: The proof fixes a good lattice \(R\) containing \(N_0\), defines \(L\) on a fundamental interval by combining \(N\) with \(R^\ast\) on one side and \(N^\ast\cap R\) on the other, and checks self-duality from the construction. The pairing estimate gives the needed inclusion at the midpoint.
